The '''High Energy Concepts and Implementation Labs Division''' was one of the [[Maw Installation]]'s organizations. The Division was headed by [[Director/Legends|Director]] [[Paldis Doxin]]. The HECIL Division was responsible for creating the [[Sun Crusher]] and the [[Metal-Crystal Phase Shifter]] projects.<ref name="Sourcebook" />
